news.title: Beryl Securities Limited Announces Executive Changes
news.body: Beryl Securities Limited appointed CS Neha Sharma (ACS:30887) as Company Secretary, Compliance Officer, and Key Managerial Personnel at the Board Meeting held on January 3, 2026, effective from January 4, 2026. Neha Sharma is a member of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI) with Membership No. A30887. The Board took note of the resignation of Mr. Kamlesh Gupta, Company Secretary, effective January 3, 2026.

news.title: Beryl Securities Limited Approves Executive Changes
news.body: The Board of the Directors of Beryl Securities Limited held on 3 January, 2026 Considered and took note of the resignation of Mr. Kamlesh Gupta from post of Company Secretary with effect from 3 January 2026 and Considered and approved appointment of Mrs. Neha Sharma as the Company secretary with effect from 4 January 2026.
